bindingProtocol.title: People · Problem · Repair
bindingProtocol.invariant: Every entrance begins with a different boundary while preserving access to the same body of work.

projection.title: Begin where the boundary is clearest.
projection.introduction: With the people living the consequence, the problem asking to be named, or the repair that restores a path.
projection.instruction: Choose one part of the instrument. You can return and enter another way at any time.

routes.label: People
routes.question: Who is here?
routes.description: Begin with the person, role, responsibility, or consequence already in view.

routes.label: Problem
routes.question: What happened?
routes.description: Begin with the pressure, failure, contradiction, or boundary asking to be named.

routes.label: Repair
routes.question: What restores the path?
routes.description: Begin with the method, instrument, and governed work of making consequence repairable.
